paper_metadata.title: A 72-mW CMOS 802.11a Direct Conversion Front-End With 3.5-dB NF and 200-kHz 1=f Noise Corner
paper_metadata.abstract: A direct conversion 802.11a receiver front-end including a synthesizer with quadrature VCO has been integrated in m CMOS process. The chip has an active area of 1.8 mm2 a 0.13with the entire RF portion operated from 1.2 V and the low frequency portion operated from 2.5 V. Its key features are a current driven passive mixer with a low impedance load that achieves a low 1 f noise corner and an high I–Q accuracy quadrature VCO. Measured noise figure is 3.5 dB with an 1 f noise corner of 200 kHz, and an IIP3 of 2 dBm. The synthesizer DSB phase noise integrated over a 10 MHz band is less than 36 dBc while its I–Q phase unbalance is below 1 degree.
